caption: The drawing depicts a pair of slip-on shoes positioned on a light beige background. The left shoe is set upright, showing its side and top, while the right shoe is placed next to it with the sole facing upwards. The shoes have a black base and are decorated with colorful, floral patterns in hues of red, green, blue, white, and yellow, resembling needlepoint or tapestry fabric. The floral motifs are distributed across the upper surface of the shoes. The soles are dark, likely black or brown, and appear worn. The interior of the shoe on the left is visible and is light brown or tan in color. The background is plain, with no additional objects or decoration visible, and the artist’s signature “LEROY GRIFFITH” is located in the lower right corner.
title: Needlepoint Slippers
